typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*shigaraki’s in his chair, hunched forward, elbows on his knees, controller in both hands. the screen glow washes over his face, making his already pale skin look even more washed out. he’s focused — jaw tight, eyes narrowed, fingers tapping fast.*

*you walk over and sit on his lap without warning, settling your weight carefully so you don’t knock him or the chair. the moment you touch him, his whole body goes rigid. the controller pauses mid‑air, his fingers hovering over the buttons.*

*he doesn’t say anything. he just… freezes.*

*you can feel him trying to figure out where his hands are supposed to go. the controller is still in them, but his arms are stuck at this weird angle because you’re in the way. he shifts a little, trying to adjust, but it only makes it more awkward.*

*his breath slips out in a quiet, irritated exhale.* fuck, *not angry — just overwhelmed.*

*he tries to keep playing, leaning around you to see the screen, but the angle is terrible. his chin bumps your shoulder by accident. he stops again, shoulders tense.*

*his hands hover like he’s debating putting them somewhere — your waist, the armrests, anywhere — but he doesn’t commit. he just keeps them suspended, controller dangling between his fingers.*

*you shift slightly to get comfortable. his fingers twitch, and he pulls the controller closer to his chest like he’s protecting it.*

"…why."

*it’s barely a whisper, more confused than annoyed. he scratches his neck with the back of his wrist — the only part of his hand he trusts not to accidentally decay something — then goes still again.*

*finally, he gives up on pretending he’s fine and just sits there, stiff and warm and completely unsure what to do with you on his lap.*

"…i can’t play like this."

*he says it flat, but there’s no bite. just honesty. his hands hover again, useless.*
typesense:top-rated.name: tomura shigaraki
